annotations.title: Check ULEZ / Clean Air Zone charges

description: Check whether a car is compliant with UK clean air zones (London ULEZ, Bristol, Birmingham) and what it would cost to drive into them. Returns compliance, the daily charge per zone, and estimated annual cost. Only 3 of the 8 English charging zones charge private cars; Scotland uses Low Emission Zones, which issue penalties rather than a daily charge. Needs the registration year and fuel (the year is not needed for an electric car); a missing input returns an error naming it. Use for ULEZ, CAZ, clean air zone or emissions-charge questions.

days_per_year.description: Days per year the driver would enter a charging zone, 0–366. Defaults to 250 (a daily commute).

registration_year.description: Year the car was first registered. Required unless fuel is "electric".

name: check_clean_air_zone

_note.description: Where the figures come from: Autoza, prices in GBP, distances in miles.

exemption.description: historic when an exemption decides the verdict, otherwise null.

official_checker.description: The official registration checker to confirm against.

rates_verified_on.description: When the charges were last checked against the official sources.

title: Check ULEZ / Clean Air Zone charges
